What are helpers?

There are two kinds of helpers.
  • Problem Hints are hints for this specific problem. The hint is pre-built according to the problem description without considering your submission.
  • Submission Assistant is a specific helps on this particular submission. The help is generated by analyzing your submission and evaluation result mainly by an LLM.
